title: Portable Troopers v215
author: Mixerdust
selftext:
**Portable troopers v215**  
New snow map implemented, two factions fight over it, its pretty neat  
AI now places barbed wire and minefields  
Further AI tactics upgrades such as combined arms, escorts, feints, AA discipline  
Improved squad tactics and user accessibility:  
You can order selected units in dragable formation like in bannerlord/total war  
By holding alt you can do it from first person, no longer having to switch cameras for detailed ordering  
Holding G brings up grenade radial menu where you can select grenades  
Holding Q brings up orders radial menu for quick squad orders  
Further Editor upgrades, now players can create weapon and vehicle variants  
Soldiers stats upgrade the more they survive, in squad menu (P) you can view their stats and dead soldier memorial  


The game is made entirely on HTML through Claude ai, it is 95% vibecoded and it is turning out to be the ultimate battlefield block sandbox, something between build and shoot, delta force and arma  
The game runs great and is very light taking only about 6mb of space on your system, it is very light on the system but full of content, it can run offline on office computers easily  
Just needs a decent processor because battles can get massive and chaotic  
I will update the game for a short while longer and then i will get on the task of implementing and testing multiplayer!  
Check it out on [Itch.io](https://mixerdust.itch.io/portable-troopers) or get it on [Indie.db](https://www.indiedb.com/games/portable-troopers-the-squad-management-voxel-war-game)
